model:
rachana: 1
sutra: pnl-explain
version: 2
description: 
match: { kind: pnl-explain, priority: 10 }
title: { pill: "Market risk · P&L explain", id: "$.RESULT_ID" }
strip:
  - { label: "Date", bind: "$.DATE", fmt: "date" }
  - { label: "Actual", bind: "$.ACTUAL", fmt: "signed0", tone: "sign", emphasis: true }
  - { label: "Explained", bind: "$.EXPLAINED", fmt: "signed0", tone: "sign" }
  - { label: "Unexplained", bind: "$.UNEXPLAINED", fmt: "signed0", tone: "sign" }
panels:
  - id: attribution
    kind: hbar
    title: "Attribution"
    key: "F2"
    rows: "$.ATTRIBUTION"
    label: "FACTOR"
    value: "PNL"
    fmt: "signed0"
    tone: "sign"
  - id: explain
    kind: waterfall
    title: "P&L waterfall (risk factors to actual, USD)"
    key: "F3"
    code: "PNLX"
    rows: "$.EXPLAIN_STEPS"
    label: "STEP"
    value: "PNL"
    fmt: "signed0"
    sum: "Actual"
    unit: "USD"
  - id: built
    kind: provenance
    title: "How this view was built"
  - id: refs
    kind: links
    title: "Linked entities"
    code: "REFS"
    area: right
keys: { F7: "link($.BOOK, 'book')", F8: "impact", F9: "raw" }
